title: Ernest Trepagnier and the drummer called Two Bits
summary: Frazier says Trepagnier played brass-band bass drum and traps but was not good; he had only heard of Two Bits.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: You remember a drummer called Two Bits?
He was called him nicknamed by Trap.
Oh, yeah, yeah. He was a bass drum player, essentially.
He played bass drum in a brass band. He played Trap drums, too. I was a drummer, yeah.
Do you remember what he played like? Was he a good drummer?
He was not a good drummer. He played with the Tuxedo Band years ago. What, Celestan's Tuxedo Band? Celestan's Baby Ridgely.
Yeah, he played as the original Tuxedo Band. He played with them bands.
You remember a drummer called Two Bits at all?
Yeah, I heard a Missy. I heard some about him. That was his nickname.
Yeah, I don't know what his proper name was.
No, I heard lots about him. Two Bits. Let's see. Now, we had another drummer, I'm trying to think now. It was in my time. All these fellas that I'm relating to, there was, lots of them I came behind.
That's all them drummers, I came behind them.
